units.source_text: “您认为我会离开您，我也没有办法，可我现在还没有这样的打算。”

en.t: If you think I am going to leave you, there is nothing I can do, but I have no such intention yet.

units.source_text: 先生根本不听我的话，他说：

en.t: Sensei did not listen to me at all. He said:

units.source_text: “可是，不提防可不行，爱情是罪恶呀。

en.t: But you must be on your guard. Love is a sin.

units.source_text: 你虽然在我这儿得不到满足，倒也没什么危险。

en.t: Although you cannot find satisfaction with me, there is at least no danger.

units.source_text: 不过——你知道吗，被女人的长发缠住时是怎样的心情？”

en.t: But do you know what it feels like to be entangled in a woman's long hair?

units.source_text: 那种心情我能够想象到，却没有亲身经历过。

en.t: I could imagine that feeling, but I had never experienced it myself.

units.source_text: 不管怎样，先生所说的罪恶的意思还是朦胧费解。

en.t: In any case, what Sensei meant by sin remained vague and hard to understand.

units.source_text: 我有点儿不高兴了。

en.t: I became somewhat displeased.

units.source_text: “先生，请您把罪恶的意思说得清楚一些。

en.t: Sensei, please explain more clearly what you mean by sin.

units.source_text: 否则的话，这个话题就到此为止吧，等我弄清楚罪恶的意思以后再说。”

en.t: Otherwise, let us end this topic here and take it up again after I understand what sin means.

units.source_text: “抱歉，我自以为跟你说了实话，可实际上却让你着急了。

en.t: I am sorry. I thought I was telling you the truth, but in fact I only made you uneasy.

units.source_text: 都是我不好。”

en.t: It is entirely my fault.

units.source_text: 先生和我从博物馆后面向莺谷方向默默走去。

en.t: Sensei and I walked silently from behind the museum toward Uguisudani.

units.source_text: 从篱笆的空隙间可以窥见宽敞的庭院中茂盛的山白竹，显得十分幽静。

en.t: Through gaps in the fence, we could glimpse thick mountain bamboo growing in a spacious garden, which looked very quiet and secluded.

units.source_text: “你知道我为什么每个月都去杂司谷墓地给朋友扫墓吗？”

en.t: Do you know why I go every month to Zoshigaya Cemetery to visit my friend's grave?

units.source_text: 先生问得很突兀，而且明明知道我回答不了。

en.t: Sensei asked this very abruptly, even though he knew perfectly well that I could not answer.

units.source_text: 我好一会儿没有说话，先生才发觉了似的说：

en.t: I said nothing for a while, and then Sensei seemed to realize it and said:

units.source_text: “我又说错了，我觉得不该让你着急，想解释一下，结果又让你着急了。

en.t: I have said the wrong thing again. I thought I should not make you uneasy and tried to explain, but the result was that I made you uneasy again.

units.source_text: 真是没办法，这个问题就谈到这儿吧。

en.t: There is no help for it. Let us leave this matter here.

units.source_text: 总之爱情是罪恶的，你能明白吗？

en.t: At any rate, love is a sin. Do you understand?

units.source_text: 而且又是神圣的。”

en.t: And it is also sacred.
